Deep Soft Tissue Leiomyoma: MRI finding: volarly placed soft tissue mass with well-defined margins and an ovoid shape in direct contact with the flexor tendons
Immunohistological finding: strong reactivity against smooth muscle actin (SMA)
Histological examination finding: spindle-shaped cells arranged in fascicles with cigar-shaped nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm
Immunohistological finding: negative reaction against S-100 and epithelial membrane antigen (EMA)
Physical examination finding: positive Tinel's sign over the median nerve at the wrist
